# Architecture

- ARC-008: No code reads the clock directly: the time comes from an injected TimeProvider, and TimeProvider.System appears only where the app registers it, or where code must agree with a clock it can't inject, such as a test token the app checks against the system clock. Assemblies marked pure (core business logic, such as a module's Domain project, marked by setting the PureAssembly property to true in its .csproj) also use no randomness, file, network, environment or process access except through what their callers pass in or inject, and BannedSymbols.Pure.txt lists the APIs they may not call.
